name: @zdreamer/forge
description: Forge workspace application and typed workspace policy contract

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && biome check . && corepack pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=error run check:server && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.mjs server/src ui/src && node --test tools/*.test.ts
scripts.check:server: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.contract.json --noEmit && biome check server && cd server && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.mjs 'src/**/*.ts' && node --test
